title: PR generated-artifact refresh registration after runner allocation

phases.objective: Restore GitHub Actions registration by resolving bounded report paths only after runner allocation.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions planner and pull-request validator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository governed pull request or exact workflow_dispatch request
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow registers, allocates a runner, binds two report paths under RUNNER_TEMP, evaluates the exact head read-only, uploads bounded evidence, and enforces the canonical decision.
steps: Plan the workflow without evaluating runner.temp in job-level env.
Allocate the Ubuntu runner and initialize a clean bounded report directory.
Publish REPORT_PATH and REPORT_MARKDOWN_PATH through GITHUB_ENV.
Validate and checkout the exact governed head without persistent credentials.
Evaluate generated artifacts read-only and upload the canonical reports.
assertions: Both report paths are initialized after runner allocation.
The workflow retains contents: read and no git push authority.
Artifact upload reads only the two bounded report files.

phases.objective: Preserve exact-head validation, read-only permissions, bounded artifact evidence, and canonical fail-closed report enforcement.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static workflow and executable regression review
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exact local and remote SHA identity is required before evaluation and the report contract determines the final outcome.
steps: Checkout the exact SHA with persist-credentials false.
Verify local and remote branch identity.
Run evidence publisher and mutation-safety regressions.
Fail closed when the canonical report is absent, malformed, secret-bearing, or blocked.
assertions: main and Production remain invalid mutation targets.
The verification workflow has contents: read only.
No force push, deployment, provider mutation, SQL, migration, or secret inclusion is introduced.

phases.objective: Prevent recurrence of unavailable pre-allocation runner contexts and unbounded report-path drift.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Any future change to the PR generated-artifact refresh workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The candidate is rejected if runner.temp returns to job-level env or the post-allocation bindings and bounded upload contract disappear.
steps: Reject any runner.temp expression in the workflow.
assertions: The regression fails before merge on unavailable runner context use.
The regression fails before merge when either report path is not bound.
Secrets are not included in evidence.

phases.objective: This registration repair has no provider canary authority.
This repair performs no Production action or deployment.
